title: Data Analysis and Pattern Recognition
description: Statistical data analysis and random processes, ergodicity and stationarity, feature extraction and selection, Bayesian decision procedures, parametric and non-parametric pattern classification and clustering techniques. Applications to big data, data science, and computer security problems.
notes: Credit will be granted for only one of ECE 485, ECE 535, ELEC 485, ELEC 535.
May be offered as a joint undergraduate and graduate class.
